⬡ 01 — The difference

A chatbot answers. An agent gets the job done.

Chatbot

You ask. It answers.

→ Waits for your prompt
→ Forgets the job when the chat ends
→ You do the follow-up work
→ Everyone already has this

Agent

You give it a job. It does it.

→ Works toward a goal in steps
→ Uses tools: files, search, email, calendars
→ Checks its own work
→ Knows when to ask a human
→ This is what you build.

⬡ 02 — The 3 days

Day 1: design it. Day 2: build it. Day 3: ship it.

Day 1 · Design

Pick a job. Design the agent.

  • → From chatbot to agent, in plain language
  • → Choose the job your agent will do
  • → Write its instructions, rules and limits
  • → First version running by lunch
Day 2 · Build

Give it tools. Make it reliable.

  • → Connect your agent to files, search and tools
  • → Give it memory and a workflow
  • → Test on 10 real cases
  • → Break it. Fix it. Repeat.
Day 3 · Ship

Prove it. Pitch it. Certify it.

  • → Safety, privacy and responsible AI
  • → Record your demo
  • → 90-second pitch to a live panel
  • → Certificate and CV pack
⬡ 03 — What will you build?

Choose the job your agent does.

Job-hunt agent

Finds roles, tailors your CV, drafts applications.

Research agent

Reads sources, compares them, writes a cited brief.

Study agent

Turns lectures and notes into a plan and quizzes.

Business agent

Answers customer questions for a business you would start.

Club or society agent

Handles sign-ups, reminders and event admin.

Your own idea

Bring a job you hate doing. We help you automate it.

⬡ 04 — What you walk away with

You leave with proof. Not a certificate alone.

On your CV

In your pocket

Problem, what your agent does, how you tested it. Fill in the template, paste it in.

⬡ 06 — Questions

Straight answers.

Do I need to code?

No. You build with no-code tools. If you can write a clear email, you can build an agent.

What do I need to bring?

A laptop and your lunch. Any major, any year.

Is lunch included?

No. Lunch is not included in the price. Bring your own or use the campus food options [confirm venue].

Is it a Microsoft certificate?

No. You receive a verified Neural Horizons AI certificate with a unique ID and QR code. We point you to Microsoft's free AI learning for next steps.

Can my university pay?

Yes. Universities and sponsors can book seats for their students. [confirm payment options]

What if I only know ChatGPT?

Perfect. Day 1 takes you from chatbot to agent.
